description.en: 01门 —— AI 代理与人类的协作前台（基于 DeepSeek Harness「一切皆插件」架构）

A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin that records what you understood while reading open-source code: quick-capture notes or full deep-reading notes, grouped into one card per repo / file / symbol, stored as Markdown + JSONL you can open in Obsidian; query past reads and link cards to notes already in your own Obsidian vault. 中文名：源码阅读档案。
模型信息补全：按模型名自动补全上下文、输出上限、思考档位和图片能力

Cosmic starfield & futuristic-tech theming for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI: one color drives the whole palette, with per-area (sidebar / conversation / rightbar) colors, local picture backgrounds and star dust.
Academic research pipeline: a 10-stage state machine, a five-seat review panel, an integrity protocol and paper metrics.

AgentTeams Pro — Deep Research Edition for DeepSeek Harness: a DeerFlow-style multi-agent deep-research harness (specialist roles + stage-gated research pipeline + evidence/citation discipline) built on the proven AgentTeams engine (captain, members, tasks with dependencies, messaging, live web panel).

Sleep, long-term memory and consolidation for DeepSeek Harness: wakefulness driven by conversation progress, deterministic consolidation into memory cards (pitfall / playbook / hotspot / unresolved), and homeostasis alert de-noising.
每日15:30自动扫描基金池，调用 invest_* 工具输出每只基金建议投资金额并写报告到DSH插件目录
Subject-agnostic mastery tutor: orient → deconstruct → model → diagnose → transfer → review, with spaced repetition.
Office document toolkit: build and extract PDF, DOCX, PPTX and XLSX, render PDF pages for visual checks, and convert between formats.

Organism kernel for DeepSeek Harness: promotes every plugin to an organ with one contract (sense / reflex / effect / homeostasis), adds a nerve bus, a heartbeat, reflex arcs, a self-healing ledger and on-demand tool-schema gating.
Multi-agent penetration brain: 13 roles, a seven-phase flow, an adviser that re-routes on failure, and a JSONL knowledge base.
🐳 The Everything-Plugin Quant OS — AI-native & DSH-native: 46 tools, 6 pluggable domains (data/alpha/ML/risk/execution), one end-to-end PDAT→PET pipeline. Methods open, secrets internal.
Reverse-engineering workflow: deterministic routing, confidence bands, an evidence chain and a validated-entry gate.
Turns source material into social cards: Xiaohongshu image sets, 21:9 + 1:1 public-account cover pairs, and Live Photo plates.
Vulnerability remediation workbench: discovery, risk scoring, virtual patch generation, and a code/config remediation plan.

Zero-residence context engine for DeepSeek Harness: evicts large tool payloads from the live context into a queryable store, keeps only pointers, and reconstructs any of them verbatim on demand — so per-turn prompt tokens stop growing with the transcript.

DeepSeek Harness 团队成本管家：按成员/项目精确计量每次模型调用的 token 用量与费用（含子代理，修复团队场景下用量少算），内置 DeepSeek 2026-09 价格表、成员日/月预算、阈值告警与 Webhook 通知、可选超支拦截、成本报表工具与 CSV 导出。Team cost captain for DeepSeek Harness: per-member, per-project token & cost metering of every model call (subagents included), with a built-in DeepSeek 2026-09 price catalog, member budgets, threshold alerts via webhook, optional over-budget enforcement, and a cost report tool with CSV export.
A right-edge DSH Web navigator for current-session questions, hover previews, and exact click-to-jump navigation.
CapMap docs visualization for DeepSeek Harness (graph + capability panel)
DSH 营销工具箱：在侧边栏底部（Settings 旁，官方 sidebar.footer.action 席位）增加「🎯 营销工具箱」模块，一键打开封面图生成 / 朋友圈文案 / 短视频脚本 / 开头黄金3秒检验四个预设营销 Agent 通道；后续工具在 lib/client.js 顶部 CHANNELS 数组中逐步添加。

DSH voice reader: read LLM replies aloud as they stream. Edge-tts built-in, any OpenAI-compatible cloud TTS plugs in via the settings panel, plus a voiced waiting-phrase ticker while the model thinks.
Feishu (Lark) tools for DeepSeek Harness: send messages, read chat history, create/read/append Feishu documents, and grant document access.
DeepSeek Harness (dsh) task-completion notifications: native desktop alerts on macOS/Windows/Linux plus zero-config phone pairing (PWA + Web Push) with optional cloudflared public tunnel.

Inline Command Code plan usage badge in the DSH composer toolbar (5h/weekly window usage + remaining credits) with an upward detail popover; reuses the commandcode/report remote from @mars-sea/dsh-commandcode-provider.
DSH web 客户端补丁：输入框高度三态管理（auto 失焦 72px/聚焦 192px、常驻展开 336px=官方原值、常驻折叠 72px），官方内容自适应机制保持原样；卡片角标按钮 + Alt+Shift+C 循环切换，localStorage 持久化。
DSH 上下文管理插件：任务边界、项目帧、自动判别与上下文优化（开发中，R2 判别域 P8–P14b1 已施工）
Isolated Gemini Cloud Code Assist OAuth for DeepSeek Harness. Independent store. Gemini flash only.
Firecrawl search provider and multi-account settings for DeepSeek Harness
Codex realtime live voice for DeepSeek Harness: WebRTC + Frameless Bidi + session delegation.
GitHub-style alerts (> [!TIP] …) rendered as callout cards in the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI
Keyboard shortcuts for the DSH Web UI: Ctrl+Q left sidebar, Ctrl+E right sidebar (dsh-better-sidebar plugin or native details fallback), Ctrl+S settings modal.
Anime maid whale desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web UI: real-time LLM dialogues, 8 mood animations, satiety reserve system, persistent speech bubble, and mobile-adapted cupboard UI.
DSH/Cordis Web plugin: a zoomable relation graph of every loaded plugin - dependencies, resolved providers, and Loader-tree nesting - as a Settings tab next to 'Plugin list'.
DeepSeek Harness engine as a lifecycle-owned Cordis plugin, extracted from ACRYL.
Pi coding agent as a lifecycle-owned Cordis runtime plugin for ACRYL.

DSH 技能包插件（汉化版）：把 mattpocock/skills 仓库的 25 个 promoted 技能（engineering 18 个 + productivity 7 个）全文汉化后打包为 host 端 Cordis 技能 provider，经 ctx.skills 注册（rank 600 bundled 级），供 DSH 技能系统发现与调用。原出处：https://github.com/mattpocock/skills（作者 Matt Pocock，MIT 许可）。
One-click brand replacement for the DSH web GUI — logo, product name, version badge, hero headline/badge/intro, tab title. Config lives at $DSH_HOME/dsh-brand.json. 一键替换 DSH Web GUI 品牌信息，方便各家二改分发。
LAN access plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web host: binds all interfaces and serves a token-gated /m/api route family for the companion mobile app
Speech capability plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web host: a token-gated /s/api route family serving audio transcription (ASR) and synthesis (TTS) over configurable providers

DSH Web plugin: per-turn cost beside the native turn-usage pill, plus a per-reply Cost-stats settings page with calendar day/month pickers, fed by a host route that folds every stored session log (replies and context compactions alike). Official DeepSeek price tables (CNY + USD), peak/off-peak aware.
Workspace tools for DeepSeek Harness: per-workspace default Agent preset and permission preset for new sessions, using only official extension points (no DSH patches required).
DSH plugin: 在左侧栏实时查看 DeepSeek 余额与 Kimi Code 用量（5 小时窗口 + 每周配额）。In-sidebar live usage monitor for DeepSeek balance and Kimi Code quota (5-hour window + weekly).
Opt-in DeepSeek Harness desktop Computer Use tools over Open Computer Use MCP
DSH 工作日志日历：全量汇总所有会话，按天登记工作时长与内容摘要，支持生成日报/周报/半年总结（Host 核心）。
Process panel for DeepSeek Harness: start, stop and watch long-running background processes from the sidebar, with live logs.

DeepSeek Harness 插件管家：在「设置 → 插件」新增标签页，用人话说明每个插件是做什么的，提供一键停用/启用（热生效）与安全卸载；同一页的「技能」分段盘点所有技能、标明唯一可用的触发方式，并给出两个真开关（模型自动加载 / 斜杠命令）。Plugin and skill manager for DeepSeek Harness: plain-language catalogs, one-click hot enable/disable, rollback-guarded uninstall, and per-skill invocation switches.
A  light TUI plugin for Deepseek Harness.

Tab Watchdog for DeepSeek Harness Web: when a workspace finishes a work round (green) or needs attention (error, question, approval) the tab title blinks with a badge. Persistent two-half plugin (host + browser).
Project PDF library with background indexing and cited page highlights for DeepSeek Harness Web
Captain 控制台：面向求职公司筛查的可恢复、多智能体 DSH 工作流。

LLM Wiki workbench for dsh-better-sidebar: browse and lint a Karpathy-style interlinked markdown wiki, open pages with the native markdown viewer, clickable [[wikilinks]] and provenance/relative .md links, and backlinks. Ships the llm-wiki agent skill.

Cross-session long-term memory for the DeepSeek Harness: a two-phase extraction/consolidation pipeline over a file-based memory workspace, recall injection, a citation feedback loop, lease-based job semantics, plus a settings page, a sidebar status panel and a memory viewer.
DSH model channel manager: roundrobin failover engine (host) + model config view tab (client).
DSH session model selector with search and reasoning-effort pane: shadows the native conversation.input.model seat (independent cordis client plugin).
DSH in-session panel view: project agent-generated self-contained HTML into a sandboxed iframe, with status bar and choice interactions delivered as real user messages.
Terminal UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness: mounts over the dsh-base profile layer through the dsh plugin mechanism, consuming the host runtime

DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: WeCom (WeChat Work) smart-robot integration over the long-connection (WebSocket) API. Per-session agents, idempotent msgid dedup, stream/markdown replies, media download/upload, whitelist, welcome/feedback events.

Set up free, encrypted, deduplicated backups of remote Linux servers, pulled from a Windows PC with Restic — tar-over-SSH streaming, zero software installed server-side, with size verification against
在会话行菜单复制规范 @session mention, 粘贴到输入框即可召回该会话上下文
Drop a forked session's inherited pending prompts, so a fork child answers the prompt you send it instead of the source session's unclaimed queue.
Recolor only the icon and title text of DSH web conversation rows, per tool or per event category, without rails or background tints.
Take over the native DSH approval window and plan review card so a reject can carry a description the model will see.
Limit the expanded thinking block to a bounded scroll window in the DSH web conversation.
Turkish (tr) language pack for DeepSeek Harness web UI

DeepSeek Harness plugin: render GeoJSON/vector data into an interactive GeoLibre map and let agents operate the live map (layers, styles, view, GeoLibre algorithms and Whitebox WASM tools) through agent tools.
洛天依桌宠：住在 DSH 里的虚拟歌姬，可拖动、可互动（抚摸/喂食/睡觉/聊天），预设动作 + 接大模型的 AI 聊天。
DeepSeek Harness web plugin: one process-control button beside the sidebar Settings row — restart the host, reload the page, or quit the host process.
ESLint Security SAST bundle and model-facing scan tool for DeepSeek Harness.
Semgrep SAST bundle and model-facing scan tool for DeepSeek Harness.
工程级会话鲁棒：官方有限次 API 重试耗尽后，对超时/传输/限流等瞬时失败继续重试直到成功或取消，会话不因瞬时 API 故障中断。

A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: orchestrates complex tasks across multiple models — a 'main brain' decomposes the task and dispatches subtasks to GLM / Kimi / Qwen etc. sub-agents by each model's strengths, with per-model token usage.

TiddlyWiki 5 as the DSH persistent knowledge base: fifteen tiddlywiki_* agent tools (filtered search/recent/tags/batch/rewrite/trash/lint + git sync & conflict resolve), a full TiddlyWiki editor embedded in the GUI center column (same-origin proxy, works over Tailscale/LAN/domain), a right-side wiki tab, a per-session summary tab, a quick-note card with draft auto-save behind a single knowledge FAB, an optional clip bookmarklet that also saves selected images as attachments, and git-based sync with auto-commit. Mounts via the official dsh plugin system — no DSH source changes.
Agent-native API Client for DeepSeek Harness — Postman 级 API 调试 UI + Agent 原生 HTTP 工具 + Postman Collection 导入的 DSH 原生插件

Per-conversation x-opencode-session header injection for OpenCode Go in DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Fixes 400 MissingSessionID, keeps prompt-cache routing optimal, scoped strictly to opencode.ai, runtime-switchable without restart.
DSH Web 暂停插件：agent 完成一轮工具交互、正要发出下一次模型请求之前暂停，保持 composer 输入框可用，人类以回车/发送放行并可携带补充文字；此暂停不打断任何在途 API 调用，模型上下文始终完整、无感知。纯插件自包含，不改 DSH 源码。
OpenList 文件同步插件（含设置面板）：自动把 DSH 对话交付文件上传到 OpenList 挂载目录，并提供该目录的完整读写工具集。
独立于 DSH 进程的后台任务（schtasks 托管）：bgjob_submit/bgjob_status 工具、网页「后台任务监控」实时面板、可选完成后通知创建者 agent（notify 参数）；支持可选 dsh 沙箱（read-only/workspace-write）约束后台任务文件效果。关 DSH 亦不影响任务运行。

Memorix memory panel for the DSH Web GUI: browse every project and memory, read full details, archive/restore and create memories — inside the session, with writes going through the official memorix CLI.
DSH plugin: SearXNG-backed search provider for ctx.web (self-hosted, 1GB-VPS friendly)
Web Push notifications for DeepSeek Harness
Voice for DeepSeek Harness: an AI voice-reply tool, a persistent voice bar, a Voice settings page, and a boot sound module — all backed by Alibaba Cloud Bailian TTS.
Self-hosted enterprise control plane plugin for DeepSeek Harness
Noteboard for the dsh web GUI: a workspace-wide infinite canvas of Markdown sticky notes (.noteboard/), with multi-canvas layouts, tag rearrange, conversation text capture, and an AI distill path.
dsh 插件：离开页面时 agent 完成任务/等待审批/提问，弹系统通知，点击跳回会话

Herald — tri-channel task notifications for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): approval requests, awaited replies, and finished jobs / subagents / workflows delivered through three independently switchable channels — in-page toasts with chimes, browser-raised OS banners, and host-direct OS toasts that keep working with the browser closed. Premium bell panel, persistent history, incremental adaptive polling.
飞书「算法组」机器人 → DSH 会话桥：在指定工作区开真会话，用 DSH 现有模型+插件执行任务并回传结论 — DSH bundle。
飞书「算法组」三人格机器人控制台：开启/关闭/重连守护进程、状态与最近动态、直达任务工作区 — DSH bundle。
控制已登录的网页版 ChatGPT 生成图片并下载到本地 — DSH bundle 插件。
插件工坊：在任意工作区按 dph 格式快速脚手架 DSH 本地插件，并维护踩坑经验库持续修正开发 — DSH bundle。
在大模型思考过程中，随时向当前会话注入纠偏/引导信息，或打断当前回合 — DSH bundle。
系统理解简报工作流：解析 PRD/PDF、分批追问澄清目标系统并沉淀 BRIEF.md，最终打包可上传交付物 — DSH bundle。
Connect DeepSeek Harness to ChatGPT models through the Codex app-server

DeepSeek Harness plugin: literature/related-work search plus one-shot Zotero import. Ships two skills (literature-search, zotero-import) and a zotero-import CLI so an agent can check an idea's novelty, then file the papers it finds straight into a running Zotero.

Calendar and clock for DeepSeek Harness: set an alarm that wakes a chosen conversation at a chosen instant, by keyword, with the system time and the drift injected into the wake. In-process timer plus a Windows Task Scheduler mirror.

组装式上下文（Assembled Context）: a context tree over the dsh session surface with per-node assemble modes (full / key / off), agent-authored presets, and a browser panel that decides what the model actually sees.

Strict gate: turns strict_check and the failure journal from tools the model may call into policy the harness enforces — repeated-failure intervention, a glob-protected critical-path gate, and an automatic post-write check.
Failure journal: every tool call that exits abnormally is written to a durable JSONL journal on disk, clustered by error signature, and readable back by the agent through a `failure_journal` tool.
Strict check: verify code and commands against real checkers instead of reading them — Lean 4 kernel checking with an axiom audit, language type/syntax checks, and static defect rules.
DSH 模型插件：监控各服务商上游 /models，列出新增模型并勾选添加（检查只读、显式应用、不自动删除）。Monitor provider model catalogs and add newly released models to DeepSeek Harness.
Workflow Console for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar speed-rail with plan/execute switch, goal lifecycle, token occupancy, and workflow launcher.

DSH web 插件：对话输入框 Markdown 编辑增强 —— 无序/有序列表自动续行、列表层级缩进阶梯（Tab 降级 / Shift+Tab 或前缀后 Backspace 升级，整棵子树联动，降级限父级下一级，顶层回归普通文本）、行内代码样式（保留字面反引号）、代码块围栏自动闭合与围栏内 Enter 保护。仅增强编辑态视觉与按键行为，发送文本保持字面 Markdown 逐字节保真。/ DSH web plugin: markdown editing aids for the composer — list continuation, the list level ladder (Tab sinks, Shift+Tab or Backspace-after-the-atom lifts, whole subtree riding, sinking capped at one level below the parent; a top-level lift unlists to plain text), inline-code styling (literal backticks kept), code-fence auto-closing with in-fence Enter protection. Edit-state visuals only; the submitted text stays literal markdown.
Inspect raw LLM requests and responses in DeepSeek Harness Web
DSH Web 公网鉴权门：token 登录 + cookie 会话，反向代理到本机 DSH Web（含 WebSocket 透传）。零外部依赖，仅 node 内置模块。
Per-session subagent model picker for DeepSeek Harness with immutable child bindings

DSH 桌面消息提醒插件：模型需要你操作（审批/方案确认/提问的可操作提醒）或回复在后台完成时，系统通知+提示音+标签页标题提醒你；可在设置页开关并切换通知语言。Desktop notification & message alerts for DeepSeek Harness web — toasts, sounds and a tab-title marker when the agent needs your input (approval / plan review / question) or a reply finishes in the background; toggleable from Settings with zh/en notification language.
Grant official-style reasoning-effort selection to hand-declared pi-ai models (DeepSeek relays and the like) in the chat box
Delete the current session from the conversation header — removes the live session and its persisted directory
Use image-generation HTTP APIs as native image models in DeepSeek Harness
Global real-time Token HUD for DeepSeek Harness Web: draggable floating window showing live output tok/s, cumulative tokens, and per-session running/retrying status across all DSH sessions.

Cherry Studio-style paste for DSH Web: pasted text/code becomes a bordered, collapsible, language-tagged card with localized names (中文/English) and a one-click remove button; restored as a fenced code block on send.
Global /btw command: one-off model Q&A that is not recorded into session memory (Claude Code /btw equivalent)
A switchable Live2D avatar stage and desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness.

dsh plugin: a 3D model library and a three-cad-viewer workbench in a '3D模型' tab, plus inline model cards and CadQuery agent tools. Models are stored server-side, so the library is shared across devices.
DeepSeek Harness 插件：模型请求 URL 含 opencode.ai 时附加 x-opencode-session 请求头，值复用请求自带的会话 id（同一对话固定、重启/断网不变、不同对话不同）。
DSH plugin: right-click settings section navigation with checkable menu to show/hide settings sections
Auditable, verifier-gated self-evolution for DeepSeek Harness.
在 DSH 设置→模型的官方模型行里补上思考强度（llm-pi-ai）与多模态（llm-pi-ai / llm-deepseek），并提供 1M/128K 容量快捷填入
在会话输入框中用 ↑/↓ 方向键召回本会话已发送的历史提示词
在官方「本轮文件改动」行之后补一行：本回合 +/− 行数统计，以及「撤回全部修改 / 重新应用修改」开关
A terminal tab for DeepSeek Harness conversations — run commands in the session workspace right beside Chat and Trajectory.
DSH plugin: Codex-style context management — token-budget notice, model-facing new_context, and handoff reset instead of summary compaction.
Lean 4 service and Harness tools for deepseek-harness.
Auto-inject user-chosen skills into DeepSeek Harness sessions and harvest skills from other agent tool dirs (~/.claude, ~/.codex, ...) as extra providers.
Drag and paste files into dsh Web with a unified preview rail; keep native images and add file references only when sending.
Declare whether a configured third-party model accepts image (multimodal) input; writes the modality into the owning provider settings and verifies it through runtime model resolution.
DataTally: verifiable public usage profiles of data assets for DeepSeek Harness. search_assets / get_asset_profile / compare_assets. DataTally records; you judge.
Customize the DeepSeek Harness Web UI fonts: UI font family, code font family, and content font size. Settings persist on the host, with local-font detection and full local font scanning.
DeepSeek Harness Web plugin: per-model input-modality selector on the Models settings page for third-party (pi-ai) providers

DSH Web plugin: a session API-cost + account-balance pill merged into the official composer stats row, with a click-open breakdown panel. Host half registers a `costPill` session projection and a loopback-only balance route; browser half renders it through the slot runtime.
Show local images read by read_image directly in the dsh Web chat

Patient auto-retry for DeepSeek Harness: honor the upstream gateway's retry_after_seconds on a 429 capacity cooldown instead of giving up after two fast retries. Optional floating countdown badge included.

DSH web plugin: Restart and Shutdown buttons in the sidebar footer. Restart relaunches the `dsh web` server on the same host/port so the tab reconnects itself; Shutdown stops the server to free the terminal and then closes the browser tab.
Living memory for DeepSeek Harness — self-tending knowledge base: nightly patrol, temporal decay, RRF hybrid recall, knowledge graph, telemetry. Built by 暖暖 (NuanNuan).
Provider-backed automatic approval review for DeepSeek Harness.

DSH 个人多功能插件：对话宽度滑块 + 思考块增强（整合 dsh-think-zh-expand）+ 界面中文化 + 官方面板补丁 + 会话删除 + 工作区分页 + 入场动效（整合 dsh-client-ui-custom），全部功能独立开关。Settings feature control page with a width slider, thinking-block enhancements, interface localization, session delete, workspace tabs and entrance motion — every feature has its own toggle.

Safe one-click plugin updater for DeepSeek Harness profiles: inventory, backup, verified update (compose + boot smoke test), automatic rollback on failure, and manual rollback. 深度求索 Harness 插件安全一键更新器:备份、更新、启动验证、失败自动回滚。
Session notes: per-session remarks with 10-color labels, pinning, a filterable all-notes overview, and an always-on bottom bar with a session-switch menu — copy buttons everywhere
DeepSeek Harness Web plugin: native image previews plus persistent non-image file-drop attachment cards
设置页「快速配对」：一键铸造 dsh 远程访问配对链接并显示二维码（依赖 remote-web-ui 的 /api/pair/issue）。

DeepSeek Harness security bundle: auto-audits newly installed plugins with the harness's own model (settings panel + batch tools), and ships the Security-Audit-Mode agent preset with the OpenAI Codex Security workflow skills and dsh_security_* scan tools. One package, one `dsh plugin add`.
Find DeepSeek Harness plugins from the dsh.so registry — like find-skill, but for dsh plugins.
Per-provider request headers in the DeepSeek Harness Models settings page, with per-conversation ${sessionId} expansion.
Drag a file into the composer to auto-fill its absolute path. Desktop app only (relies on the Electron preload path bridge).
Pre-visit due diligence and company research in DeepSeek Harness with Host-tracked progress, fixed-route Qichacha MCP calls, entity confirmation, and downloadable reports.
Tender search and bid intelligence in DeepSeek Harness with proposed project search, rule screening, human review and Excel/PDF exports using user-authorized Qichacha MCP.
本地优先的 Harness 运行遥测插件：记录请求、模型、工具与插件生命周期指标（延迟、Token、成本、错误、缓存），默认不采集内容。Local-first Harness telemetry plugin for DeepSeek Harness. npm 包 dsh-local-telemetry（dsh-telemetry 名已被第三方占用）。
Codex-style lossless-retrieval context manager for the DeepSeek Harness: token-budgeted sliding window, persistent working notes, and cold-history search over the append-only session log
